description.value:
Requirements Your core is in a space that can fit a creature of your hardlight body's size, and your core isn't projecting your hardlight body

Effect Your core projects your hardlight body into its space in a standing position, with your core nestled safely inside. As part of this action, you can don armor and any number of worn items that are in your space or stored in your core's virtual storage, and you can draw items that are in your space or stored in your core's virtual storage.
